    sys.stderr.write(
        u'{warn}[WARN] {title}:{reset}\n{trace}'
        u'{warn}----------------------------{reset}\n\n'.format(
            warn=color(colorama.Back.RED + colorama.Fore.WHITE

            trace=''.join(format_exception(*exc_info))))

The issue is clear. In `thefuck/shells.py`, the `Fish.how_to_configure()` method (line 201-202) returns `'eval thefuck --alias'` as the instruction for configuring the fish shell alias. However, fish's `eval` only processes the first line of a multi-line string, and `thefuck --alias` outputs a multi-line function. The correct fish-compatible approach is to convert newlines to semicolons: `eval (thefuck --alias | tr '\n' ';')`.
